help.deployment_frequency: Number of deployments over the lookback window. A high frequency means smaller, less risky batches of change.
help.lead_time: Median time from a PR/MR's first commit to its merge — how long a change takes to be ready to ship.
help.change_failure_rate: Share of failed deployments among those with a known status. Deployments with an undetermined status are excluded.
help.mttr: Median time between a failed deployment and the next successful one on the same environment.
help.coding_time: Median time from the first commit to the PR/MR being opened.
help.pickup_time: Median time from the PR/MR being opened to its first review. Where the platform exposes no review, the first comment by someone else stands in for it — an approximation, not an equivalence.
help.review_time: Median time from the first review to the merge. Same approximation as pickup time on platforms with no native review.
help.deploy_time: Median time from the PR/MR being merged to the deployment that carried it. Grouped by where it landed: filtering on type=Prod gives the delay to production. Correlated by repo and date — a connector never exposes the commits a deployment contains — so read it as an upper bound.

collect.running: Collecting… a first run over a large scope takes minutes

refresh.title: Re-read {{name}}
refresh.explain: The whole history this source keeps is read again from its platform, rather than what changed since the last run. It runs in the background — you can leave this page. It is the most expensive thing this page starts, and on a wide scope it spends a large part of the API budget.
refresh.rebuilds: It also replays the DORA metric history over that depth: the readings of those days are recomputed from what has just been ingested, with the classification rules as they stand today, and replace the ones taken at the time. Anything older is kept as it is.
refresh.keepWindow: Leave it as it is (follows the reporting window)
refresh.keepDays: Leave it as it is ({{days}} days)
refresh.depthUnchanged: the source keeps the depth it already has
refresh.depthPersists: this becomes the source's depth, from now on — the purge sweeps at it too
refresh.evicted: Re-read finished — the queue no longer holds how it went.

default.make: Open on this source by default

rebuild.title: Replay the metric history of “{{name}}”
rebuild.explain: Recomputes the DORA readings of past days from the data already collected, using the classification rules as they stand today. No platform listing beyond one read.
rebuild.depthHint: counted back from yesterday; today is left to the next collection
rebuild.olderKept: Anything older is kept as it is, classified the way it was then — the two will sit on one curve.
rebuild.defaultDays: As many days as the reporting window
rebuild.windowNote: This says how many days are rewritten, not what each of them measures: every replayed reading covers the reporting window ending on its own day, as the scheduled collection does. To change that, change the window in Settings, then replay.

jobs.subject: Subject
